title: Flash8 re-theme Wave B: Timeline.tsx → light Halo + content tokens
description: Convert packages/authoring-ui/src/Timeline.tsx to the Flash 8 light theme using packages/authoring-ui/src/theme/flash8Theme.ts (created in Wave A, commit 51c5e3b) and matching docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md. Replace ALL hardcoded dark hex with tokens: chrome.* for panel chrome/text/borders (light #ECECEC, Tahoma 11px, near-black text), content.* for the Flash-drawn timeline elements — frame ruler header (~23px light gray), empty frame #FFFFFF, gridline #EBE9ED (8px frame pitch, ~18px layer row), keyframe filled #000000 / hollow white, motion tween span #CCCCFF + black arrow, shape tween #CCFFCC, broken tween dashed, selected frame/span #335EA8, playhead #CC0000, layer eye/lock/outline columns. Mirror the Shell.tsx reference conversion pattern. Match the spec's Timeline section (3.2) exactly. Build+authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable). If you can screenshot the timeline to confirm it reads light/Flash-8, do so. ACQUIRE the task lock first; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry to origin/main. Scope: Timeline.tsx only (+ read-only theme import).
